# pvecli cluster guests

Start, shut down, suspend or migrate many guests in one go.

## start

Start (or resume) every guest matching the filters.

```text
pvecli cluster guests start [OPTIONS]
```

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-vm`, `--vms VALUE` | Guest IDs: 100,101 or 100-110. |
| `-tg`, `--tag VALUE` | Only guests carrying this tag. |
| `-pl`, `--pool VALUE` | Only guests of this resource pool. |
| `-n`, `--node VALUE` | Only guests currently on this node. |
| `-mw`, `--max-workers N` | Guests handled at the same time. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |

## shutdown

Shut down every guest matching the filters.

```text
pvecli cluster guests shutdown [OPTIONS]
```

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-vm`, `--vms VALUE` | Guest IDs: 100,101 or 100-110. |
| `-tg`, `--tag VALUE` | Only guests carrying this tag. |
| `-pl`, `--pool VALUE` | Only guests of this resource pool. |
| `-n`, `--node VALUE` | Only guests currently on this node. |
| `-t`, `--timeout N` | Shutdown timeout per guest, in seconds. |
| `--force-stop` | Hard stop guests still running after the timeout. |
| `-mw`, `--max-workers N` | Guests handled at the same time. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |

## suspend

Suspend every VM matching the filters (containers cannot be suspended).

```text
pvecli cluster guests suspend [OPTIONS]
```

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-vm`, `--vms VALUE` | Guest IDs: 100,101 or 100-110. |
| `-tg`, `--tag VALUE` | Only guests carrying this tag. |
| `-pl`, `--pool VALUE` | Only guests of this resource pool. |
| `-n`, `--node VALUE` | Only guests currently on this node. |
| `--to-disk` | Hibernate to disk instead of pausing in memory. |
| `-mw`, `--max-workers N` | Guests handled at the same time. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |

## migrate

Migrate every guest matching the filters to one node.

```text
pvecli cluster guests migrate TARGET [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `TARGET` | Target node. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-vm`, `--vms VALUE` | Guest IDs: 100,101 or 100-110. |
| `-tg`, `--tag VALUE` | Only guests carrying this tag. |
| `-pl`, `--pool VALUE` | Only guests of this resource pool. |
| `-n`, `--node VALUE` | Only guests currently on this node. |
| `-wl`, `--with-local-disks` | Copy local disks during live migrations. |
| `-mw`, `--max-workers N` | Migrations running at the same time. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
